# construct

> The Construct — an interactive-fiction engine where the world's truth is
> a database and the model is only a voice. A host over pattern-buffer:
> it classifies the player's move, adjudicates it against the map,
> advances a hidden story arc, and only then lets a model narrate. Object
> permanence, per-character knowledge frames, as-of queries — put a thing
> down, walk away, come back: it's still there. Pre-1.0, research active;
> 800+ tests green; evaluated over a 5-scenario live corpus plus an
> adversarial critic campaign.

Vocabulary: pattern-buffer holds a world's pattern -> the Construct loads
it into a played -> holonovel (one played world, ingested from a book or
built live). Design bet: structural absence over instruction — secrets
never enter a character's window; the plot frame never enters the
narrator's briefing; free-text writes pass one Entity Authority seam.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): research question, architectural contributions,
  evaluation methodology, honest capability status. Start here.
- [docs/design/00-INDEX.md](docs/design/00-INDEX.md): the curated map of
  all 60 design docs, by layer.
- [docs/CONCEPT.md](docs/CONCEPT.md): founding brief — vision, session-zero,
  host architecture, the arc layer.
- [docs/design/OPTIMAL-IF-EXPERIENCE.md](docs/design/OPTIMAL-IF-EXPERIENCE.md):
  the research synthesis — five pillars of the optimal interactive-fiction
  experience, grounded in the evaluation corpus.
- [docs/design/eval/00-CONSOLIDATED-REPORT.md](docs/design/eval/00-CONSOLIDATED-REPORT.md):
  the evaluation suite's consolidated engineering report; eval/09 is the
  adversarial critic campaign.
- [docs/design/ARC-LAYER.md](docs/design/ARC-LAYER.md): the hidden arc —
  pacing as navigation, anti-railroading by construction.
- [docs/design/CONCLUSION-AND-OUTCOME.md](docs/design/CONCLUSION-AND-OUTCOME.md):
  conclusion-as-effect — turns never force a close.
- [docs/design/ENTITY-AUTHORITY.md](docs/design/ENTITY-AUTHORITY.md): the
  one disciplined write seam (bind-before-mint, channel-scoped minting,
  first-mention permanence).
- [docs/design/INGESTION-FIDELITY-REPAIR.md](docs/design/INGESTION-FIDELITY-REPAIR.md):
  the build-seal coreference/typing repair — a tiered, safest-first host
  pass that de-fragments an ingested world, arc-vouched merges only for
  load-bearing ids, fail-open.
- [docs/design/SHAPE-PLACE-GRANULARITY.md](docs/design/SHAPE-PLACE-GRANULARITY.md):
  shape-aware place granularity — intimate/domestic shapes author the
  interior at room scale and the opening anchors to the most specific
  co-asserted place, not the enclosing city.
- [docs/design/LIVING-WORLD-GENERATOR.md](docs/design/LIVING-WORLD-GENERATOR.md)
  + [docs/design/LIVING-WORLD-GENERATOR-P2.md](docs/design/LIVING-WORLD-GENERATOR-P2.md):
  the regenerative arc engine — a portfolio of arcs with lifecycle and
  fallout-as-canon, and the opportunistic DM that mints side arcs from
  fallout, the player's committed delta (salience-gated), or diegetic
  quiet, behind six guards + dramatic right-of-way.
- [docs/design/REMEMBRANCER.md](docs/design/REMEMBRANCER.md): the player's
  own memory as a turn participant + player-authored retcon with
  contradiction quarantine.
- [docs/design/TURN-LOOP.md](docs/design/TURN-LOOP.md): the per-turn DAG
  (serial mutation spine + parallel assembly fan-out) and model tiers.
- [docs/LEXICON.md](docs/LEXICON.md): naming discipline.

## Built on

- pattern-buffer (https://github.com/5000Stadia/pattern-buffer): the
  append-only world-state engine. The Construct is a host over it; it
  never reimplements engine concepts.
- Kernos (https://github.com/5000Stadia/Kernos): the cohort architecture
  the turn loop borrows, and the house methodology (design-first,
  adversarially reviewed, receipts-first).
